rental.title: Modern Newlands Apartment with Mountain Views
rental.description:
This neat little two bedroom cottage is situated on a beautiful flat peace of ground a stones throw away from the beach.

The property is fully walled with an electric gate and has a lovely lush manicured garden.
It consists of a cosy lounge a galley fitted kitchen and two rooms with a newly refurbished bathroom.

This home has huge potential to build on and extend and is a hop skip and jump to the beach.
Add on another story and you will have gorgeous sea views or keep the cottage as a granny flat or guest cottage and build the home of your dreams on the property there is ample space.

sale.title: Contemporary Sandton Family Home
sale.description: Very spacious family home offering 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, massive kitchen with a pantry and a scullery, spacious lounge, dining area, study, 2 full bathrooms, pool, double carport and more parking space, this property is a must have for an entertainer. It's available immediately. It's available furnished or unfurnished, if you want it furnished the price will be more and discussed.
